title: Procurement of 3 core x 6 sqmm Copper Armoured Cable for water pump at Oyster Rock Lighthouse
summary: E-tender for supply and laying of 3-core 6 sq mm copper armoured XLPE power cable for the water pump at Oyster Rock Lighthouse (island off Karwar, Karnataka), issued by the Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa.

procurement.issuing_office: Directorate of Lighthouses and Lightships, Deep Bhavan, Near GMC Stadium, Bambolim, Goa

sites.name: Oyster Rock Lighthouse (Island), R/T Building, Kaju Baug, Post Karwar, Dist. Kanera
sites.work: Supply and laying of 3C x 6 sq mm copper armoured cable for water pump

scope.item: Supply of 3 core x 6 sqmm copper armoured LT XLPE power cable

Laying of one number PVC insulated and PVC sheathed/XLPE power cable, 1.1 kV grade, direct in ground incl. excavation, sand cushioning, protective covering and refilling (printed '65sqmm x 3core armoured XLPE power cable for water pump')
Transportation (road and boat) & labour charges, clamps, SS cable tie, screw etc.

money.performance_security: 3% of contract value by BG/FDR within 15 days of LoI, valid 3 months after expiry of 2-year warranty
money.notes: Estimate inclusive of GST. EMD by DD/FDR of any nationalised bank in favour of The Director of Lighthouses and Lightships, Goa, valid 90 days from publishing; original EMD and tender fee (DD) by 28.05.2024 12:00. MSME bidders in eligible category may submit Bid Security Declaration (Form 9.6) instead of EMD.

period.completion: 15 days from the date of award of contract (NIT); SCC 5.4 says 90 days from signing of agreement
period.warranty: 2 years from completion/acceptance; defects rectified at contractor's cost

eligibility: OEMs or authorised agents, or appropriate class contractors registered with CPWD/State PWD/Railways/MES/BSNL or other Government/PSU/autonomous bodies

Similar works in last 7 years: one >= Rs 2,14,720, or two >= Rs 1,61,040 each, or three >= Rs 1,07,360 each, for Central/State Govt/PSU/private firm; similar work = electrification works, ESE lightning arrester, electrical UG cable works
Minimum 3 years' experience in similar work
Company registration; valid electrical works licence; PAN and GST; ITRs for any three assessment years; CA-certified average annual turnover for 3 years (min Rs 2.07 lakh per evaluation table)
Technical brochures and make/model of proposed cable; tender acceptance letter, undertaking, non-blacklist affidavit (Forms 9.3-9.5)
Technical evaluation out of 100 (statutory 35, financial 20, experience 20, performance 20, cable make/model 5); minimum 70% to open commercial bid; lowest-priced qualified bidder wins
specs: 3 core x 6 sq mm copper armoured LT XLPE power cable, 1.1 kV grade
Conductor per IS:8130:2013; high voltage resistance test report required before supply
Works per State Electricity Board specs, else CPWD General Specifications for Electrical Works 2013 Part-I
notes: Scanned 36-page bid document with a poor OCR text layer (garbled Hindi and digits); NIT (p3), eligibility (p9), evaluation (p27) and BOQ (p28) re-rendered and read from images, other sections (instructions, GCC, SCC, forms) confirmed as boilerplate from text. Inconsistencies: completion 15 days in NIT vs 90 days in SCC; BOQ laying item says '65sqmm x 3core' although cable is 6 sq mm; 220 m supplied vs 200 m laid; Form 9.1 footnote reads 'three percent (05%)'; SCC 5.20 refers to laws of the State of Tamil Nadu. Site reached by machine boat from Karwar port. Bid download/submission 17.05.2024 12:00 to 27.05.2024 16:00; technical bids opened 28.05.2024 16:00.
